author: GameSpot
description:
Check out this animated for Slay the Spire 2, coming to Steam Early Access March 5, 2026.

The ultimate roguelike deckbuilder returns!

For 1,000 years, the Spire lay dormant, its secrets buried and its horrors forgotten. Now, it has reopened, hungrier and more dangerous than ever, devouring all who dare to ascend.

New perils demand sharper strategies, relentless cunning, and unwavering resolve. Outwit the Spire’s brutal trials and uncover the truths hidden at its peak.

Will you attempt the climb alone or enlist the aid of your fellow adventurers?

author: GameSpot
description:
The Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game is available now on Nintendo eShop. The physical version launches April 16, 2026, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

Join up with BLADE to explore the planet Mira and help bring humanity back from the edge of extinction, now with a faster frame rate (up to 60 fps) and enhanced resolution (up to 4K).

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game by purchasing the upgrade pack.

Are you excited to jump back into Xenoblade Chronicles X?
